channel.title: Daily Tech Opinions Digest
channel.description: Daily digest of interesting tech opinions and blog posts.

item.title: Zvi Mowshowitz: Scott Alexander's Against SURA Seems Deeply Confused
item.description: A point-by-point rebuttal of Scott Alexander's case against unilateral AI pauses: quitting labs and raising alarms demonstrably works, and the Plan A vs Plan C tradeoff is misframed.

item.title: Cory Doctorow: Autodoxing
item.description: A new AI infostealer that doxes victims as it hacks them is the foreseeable payoff of decades of hostility to privacy and encryption — data is the new oily rag.

item.title: Bruce Schneier: AI Vulnerability Finding
item.description: 3% of all 'critical' software security bugs ever recorded were found in the last month — on pace for ~100,000 more this year. It is a new world.
